### Create Pipeline
POST /opportunities/pipelines
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/opportunities/pipelines
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/opportunities/create-pipeline | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/opportunities/create-pipeline.md

Creates a new pipeline with at least one stage for a given location. Pipeline names must be unique per location (case-insensitive), and stage names must be unique within the pipeline. To enable manual win probability, set `useOpportunityProbability` to `true` and provide a `stageWinProbability` (0–100) on every stage — if any stage is missing a value, the system falls back to auto-computed probabilities based on stage position.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: pipelines.create

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreatePipelineDto:
- name* string (e.g. "pipeline") - Name of the pipeline
- stages* string[] - List of stages belonging to this pipeline
- showInFunnel boolean - Whether the pipeline is shown in the funnel view
- showInPieChart boolean - Whether the pipeline is shown in the pie chart view
- useOpportunityProbability boolean - Whether stage-level win probability is enabled for this pipeline
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Identifier of the location (sub-account) this pipeline belongs to
- colorRenderMode string (enum: dot | bg-tint | none; e.g. "dot") - How pipeline/stage colors are rendered

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- id string - Unique identifier of the pipeline
- name string - Name of the pipeline
- stages any[][] - Stages belonging to this pipeline
- showInFunnel boolean - Whether the pipeline is shown in the funnel view
- showInPieChart boolean - Whether the pipeline is shown in the pie chart view
- locationId string - Identifier of the location (sub-account) this pipeline belongs to
- useOpportunityProbability boolean - Whether stage-level win probability is enabled for this pipeline
- colorRenderMode string (enum: dot | bg-tint | none) - How pipeline/stage colors are rendered
- position string - Fractional-index key used to sort pipelines. Updated when the user reorders pipelines (via drag-and-drop or the reorder modal).

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### Delete Pipeline
DELETE /opportunities/pipelines/{pipelineId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/opportunities/pipelines/{pipelineId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/opportunities/delete-pipeline | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/opportunities/delete-pipeline.md

Permanently deletes a pipeline and all opportunities within it. This action is irreversible — all opportunities across every stage of this pipeline will be removed. Ensure you have migrated or exported any opportunities before calling this endpoint.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: pipelines.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- pipelineId* string (e.g. "aWdODOBVOlH1RUFKWQke") - The unique identifier of the pipeline

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- success boolean - Whether the pipeline was successfully deleted
- message string - Error message if the deletion failed

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### Update Pipeline
PUT /opportunities/pipelines/{pipelineId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/opportunities/pipelines/{pipelineId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/opportunities/update-pipeline | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/opportunities/update-pipeline.md

Updates an existing pipeline. The `stages` array is a full replacement — include the `id` field on existing stages to retain them, or omit it to create a new stage. You cannot remove all stages at once. Any opportunities in removed stages are automatically migrated to the lowest-position remaining stage. Pipeline and stage names must remain unique (case-insensitive) within the location. Documentation Link - https://doc.clickup.com/8631005/d/h/87cpx-709536/75a21483123abd7

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: pipelines.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- pipelineId* string (e.g. "aWdODOBVOlH1RUFKWQke") - The unique identifier of the pipeline

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdatePipelineDto:
- name string (e.g. "pipeline") - Name of the pipeline
- stages string[] - List of stages belonging to this pipeline
- showInFunnel boolean - Whether the pipeline is shown in the funnel view
- showInPieChart boolean - Whether the pipeline is shown in the pie chart view
- useOpportunityProbability boolean - Whether stage-level win probability is enabled for this pipeline
- colorRenderMode string (enum: dot | bg-tint | none; e.g. "dot") - How pipeline/stage colors are rendered

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- id string - Unique identifier of the pipeline
- name string - Name of the pipeline
- stages any[][] - Stages belonging to this pipeline
- showInFunnel boolean - Whether the pipeline is shown in the funnel view
- showInPieChart boolean - Whether the pipeline is shown in the pie chart view
- locationId string - Identifier of the location (sub-account) this pipeline belongs to
- useOpportunityProbability boolean - Whether stage-level win probability is enabled for this pipeline
- colorRenderMode string (enum: dot | bg-tint | none) - How pipeline/stage colors are rendered
- position string - Fractional-index key used to sort pipelines. Updated when the user reorders pipelines (via drag-and-drop or the reorder modal).

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)
